reviewer: Codex source-fidelity review; same development agent
scope: All 25 authored definitions compared against retained source definitions; prerequisites and limits assessed separately as product guidance.
nextGate: Choose task and corpus balance, retain attribution, define held-out concept evaluation, and run the normal corpus verifier before any training intake.

results.findings: Paraphrase preserves RPC operations and potential suspicious activity. Requires decoded RPC, not wireless headers.
Preserves IPC deviation analysis. Host IPC records are outside ordinary Hunter radio evidence.
Preserves remote terminal detection; authorization context is required to call a session unauthorized.
Preserves internal/external relaying. Requires network roles and both sides of a path; one radio address is insufficient.
Faithful metadata/outlier definition. Baseline and intent limitations are correctly separated product guidance.
Preserves directional volume comparison. Coverage and interval requirements prevent partial-capture ratios from being treated as full traffic.
Preserves domain metadata/reputation-like assessment. SSIDs and MACs cannot substitute for DNS records.
Preserves application-command analysis; decryption and authorization requirements prevent inferred hidden commands.
Faithful inbound session/attempt volume paraphrase. Attempts remain distinct from completed connections.
Preserves baseline communities and divergent inter-community communication; a new relationship is not itself an attack.
Preserves request/response payload baseline comparison; length alone does not reveal encrypted content.
Preserves administrative-protocol baseline comparison; an unfamiliar address is not authorization evidence.
Preserves failed-connection analysis. Requires evidence of outcome, not just EAPOL presence.
Faithful known-signature comparison. A negative match is not a general safety determination.
Preserves certificate misconfiguration/spoofing analysis. Certificates require PKI fields and supporting context, not an SSID.
Faithful passive-source certificate collection/analysis. No active collection workflow is introduced.
Preserves user-session duration analysis. Captured frame span is explicitly not a complete session.
Preserves authorization event/baseline comparison. Correctly distinguishes authorization from authentication.
Preserves authentication event/baseline comparison. Exchange traffic alone does not establish login success.
Preserves user-resource access analysis. Radio addresses cannot provide user authorization context.
Preserves user transfer volume analysis. User/session attribution requires separate evidence.
Faithful IP reputation paraphrase. Dated reputation is context, not capture-specific incident proof.
Faithful domain reputation paraphrase. Domain results cannot be transferred to unrelated radio identifiers.
Preserves known-malicious-identifier presence checks. Matches do not identify a physical person.
Preserves deceptive string comparison. Applying it to observed names is explicitly authored guidance, not proof of malicious ownership.

limitations: Same-agent review is not independent expert validation.
No measured radio capability, user comprehension, field detection or incident label is established.
No input file or ongoing training mixture was changed.
